 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : None.
 For the Opposite Party/s : None.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 20-02-2023 No one appears on call.

This is an application for quashing of the cognizance order dated 29.4.2015 passed by the court of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Samastipur whereby cognizance was taken under Sections 498A, 323/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
It seems that the petitioner has lost interest in the matter.
Accordingly, the petition stands dismissed for non- prosecution with liberty to raise all the points before an appropriate Court at an appropriate stage.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Ajay Singh/-
